mechanism: Both rasagiline (irreversible MAOi) and St. John's Wort (MAOI properties) inhibit monoamine oxidase, creating risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis through additive monoaminergic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; St. John's Wort is contraindicated with all MAOis including rasagiline due to serious serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis risk.
